reviews.title: Great looking fans!
reviews.comment: I used these 140mm fans to replace the stock NZXT fans in my case. The lighting looks great, and can get very bright. They are also much quieter than the fans that used to be in the case. One thing that would have been nice to have is the ability to daisy-chain the fans together, I didn't have enough open fan headers on my motherboard and ended up having to buy a fan hub separately to power and light up all of these fans.
reviews.author: Abhi
